products.name: Argan Oil 15ml
products.description: Travel size, rich in vitamin E. Ideal for skin and hair daily use.
products.fullDescription: Argan oil is a 100% natural cosmetic oil. Rich in Vitamin E, fatty acids, and antioxidants. This oil is a multifunctional moisturizer that helps nourish and protect the skin, hair, and nails.
products.benefits: Nourishes and stimulates skin regeneration. Has anti-aging properties and improves elasticity. Strengthens hair fibers and helps prevent split ends. 100% natural and rich in vitamin E (tocopherols).
products.usage: Face: Apply 2–3 drops and gently massage into the skin in the evening. Hair: Apply to the ends or use as a nourishing mask before washing. Body: Apply after showering on damp skin for maximum hydration.

products.name: Nila Powder 100gr
products.description: Mineral mask used for brightening, softening, and hydrating the skin.
products.fullDescription: NILA powder is a natural mineral or plant-based powder traditionally used in skincare in North Africa. It is used for brightening, softening, and hydrating the skin, especially in rough areas such as knees, elbows, and underarms.
products.benefits: Brightens and improves skin tone. Reduces the appearance of dark spots and hyperpigmentation. Gives the skin a natural glow. Provides deep pore cleansing.
products.usage: Mix with rose water or yogurt until a smooth paste is formed. Apply as a mask for 10–15 minutes. Use 1–2 times per week.

products.name: Prickly Pear Seed Oil 30ml
products.description: Known for its anti-aging effect, rich in Vitamin E, Vitamin K, and essential fatty acids.
products.fullDescription: A luxurious and lightweight oil extracted from the seeds of Opuntia ficus-indica. This oil is considered one of the most valuable skincare oils. Prickly pear seed oil is fast-absorbing and derived from cactus seeds (Opuntia ficus-indica). Known for its anti-aging properties, it is rich in Vitamin E, Vitamin K, and essential fatty acids. It is highly valued for skincare, haircare, and nail care.
products.benefits: Rich in antioxidants with powerful protective properties. Deeply hydrates and strengthens the skin barrier. Improves elasticity and natural skin glow. Nourishes hair and strengthens brittle nails.
products.usage: Face: Apply 2–3 drops on clean skin, preferably in the evening. Hair: Apply a small amount to the ends or use as a pre-wash treatment. Nails: Massage 1 drop into cuticles daily.

products.name: Nila Mask 200gr
products.description: Helps brighten, soften, and deeply cleanse the skin while reducing pigmentation and dark spots.
products.fullDescription: Traditional Moroccan skincare products formulated with blue indigo powder. They help brighten, soften, and deeply cleanse the skin while reducing pigmentation and dark spots.
products.benefits: Detoxifies and deeply cleanses the skin. Brightens and evens skin tone. Leaves the skin soft and refreshed.
products.usage: Apply to the face and body. Leave on for 10–20 minutes. Rinse with water and apply moisturizer.

products.name: Aker Fassi Powder 100gr
products.description: Used as a natural pigment for lips and cheeks, giving a fresh and natural look.
products.fullDescription: Aker Fassi powder is a traditional beauty product from Morocco, made from dried poppy petals and pomegranate peel. It is used as a natural pigment for lips and cheeks, offering a fresh and natural appearance.
products.benefits: Contains antioxidant and anti-aging properties. Enhances the skin’s natural glow.
products.usage: Mix with a small amount of water or argan oil. Apply as a blush or lip tint.

products.name: Tbrima Mask 200gr
products.description: Used in traditional hammam rituals for deep cleansing and skin softening.
products.fullDescription: Tbrima is a traditional Moroccan blend made with herbs and clay, used as a scrub or body mask. It is commonly used in traditional hammam rituals for deep cleansing and softening the skin.
products.benefits: Soothes sensitive skin. Helps relieve irritation. Provides natural cleansing and a refreshing feeling. Improves skin texture.
products.usage: Apply to clean skin and rinse with lukewarm water after 10 minutes.

products.name: Aker Fassi Mask 200gr
products.description: Revitalizing mask for tired and dull skin.
products.fullDescription: Aker Fassi Mask is a traditional Moroccan skincare treatment known for its brightening and antioxidant properties.
products.benefits: Promotes skin regeneration. Gives a natural and fresh glow. Enriches the skin with antioxidants.
products.usage: Apply to the face for 10–15 minutes. Use once a week.

products.name: Nila Scrub 200gr
products.description: Helps exfoliate, brighten, and soften the skin while reducing roughness and dark spots.
products.fullDescription: NILA Scrub is a natural skincare product inspired by Moroccan traditions and formulated with blue NILA powder. It helps exfoliate, brighten, and soften the skin while reducing roughness and the appearance of dark spots.
products.benefits: Removes dead skin cells. Softens the skin and cleanses pores. Improves skin texture and appearance.
products.usage: Apply to damp skin. Massage in circular motions for 2–3 minutes. Rinse thoroughly with warm water.

products.name: Black Soap 200gr
products.description: Traditional plant-based soap known for its deep cleansing and exfoliating properties.
products.fullDescription: African Black Soap is a traditional plant-based soap known for its deep cleansing and exfoliating properties.
products.benefits: Deeply cleanses the skin. Prepares the body for exfoliation. Softens and detoxifies the skin.
products.usage: Apply during a warm shower. Leave on for 5–10 minutes. Follow with exfoliation using a Kessa glove.

products.name: Rose Water 100ml
products.description: A fragrant and multifunctional liquid widely used in natural skincare.
products.fullDescription: Rose Water is a fragrant and multifunctional liquid widely used in natural skincare.
products.benefits: Hydrates and refreshes the skin. Works as a natural toner. Soothes skin irritation. Prepares the skin for other treatments.
products.usage: Apply as a toner after cleansing the skin. Use as a refreshing facial mist during the day. Mix into natural masks for extra hydration.

products.name: Kessa Exfoliating Glove
products.description: Traditional accessory for deep exfoliation and removal of dead skin cells.
products.fullDescription: The Kessa glove is a traditional accessory used in Moroccan hammam rituals. It helps deeply exfoliate the skin, remove dead skin cells, and improve skin texture.
products.benefits: Removes dead skin cells. Helps cleanse pores. Leaves the skin softer and smoother.
products.usage: Use with gentle circular motions after a warm shower or after applying black soap.
